scope: Current public Posten four-digit register, manual, address-data terms and Kartverket/data.norge Postnummerområder metadata were audited without contacting a provider, registering, authenticating, accepting terms, purchasing data, querying protected address/building/cadastral/land rows, or creating a repository or publication destination.

countryIdentity.rule: Norway retains repository NO. Posten county-like 21/22 classifications for Svalbard and Jan Mayen are operational source fields and never silently merge registered NO and SJ identities.

m2Definition.definition: A current complete Posten four-digit assignment and G/P/B/S denominator is usable under reviewed AGID processing and public-serving terms and reconciled to a pinned current Kartverket Postnummerområder Polygon/MultiPolygon release under CC BY 4.0. Edition, effective date, attribution, byte length, SHA-256, CRS, topology, coverage, exclusions, territory handling and reproducible transformation are fixed in an approved immutable artifact. The real NO API/app normalizes NNNN, returns only valid real areas, fits and renders a translucent fill with clear outline and shows selected code, geometry kind, official/derived/virtual class, source, reference date and confidence; P/O-box, special and unmatched codes remain explicit non-areas and no municipality, point, building, buffer, hull, Voronoi/raster or synthetic proxy satisfies M2.

officialObservations.finding: Posten says the tables contain all postcodes used for addressing mail in Norway and are valid from 2025-10-01. The direct Windows-1252 TAB file has 5,122 unique four-digit rows.
The manual defines G street-address, P P.O.-box, B combined and S non-address special-service categories and explains county-like 21 Svalbard and 22 Jan Mayen classifications.

The separately sold street/address register is internal-use only and may not be resold. Those terms are not treated as the postcode-table licence, but no dataset-specific postcode-table AGID public-serving grant was found.

The governmental catalogue identifies official postcode extents, says P.O.-box codes are additional, advertises GeoJSON/GML/GDB/SOSI and WFS/WMS/Geonorge access, reports monthly updates and labels the distributions CC BY 4.0.

DNS resolved the official hosts, but repeated IPv4 HTTPS/HTTP requests to WFS and Geonorge download endpoints timed out at 15-30 seconds. This is an availability observation, not proof that the product is absent. No fixed geometry body was pinned.

reproducibility.method: Verify six exact body lengths and SHA-256 values; decode the full Windows-1252 TAB register; validate every five-field row, four-digit postcode, municipality code and G/P/B/S category; compute uniqueness, category, municipality and 21/22 metrics; verify the current Posten and data.norge metadata signals.

dataQuality.risk: The assignment register is complete and internally valid as a current reference, and the official area product is openly licensed, but Posten public-serving rights are not established and no fixed Kartverket geometry body, digest, topology audit or assignment/non-area reconciliation was produced.

browserReview.reason: No approved fixed Posten/Kartverket reconciled artifact exists. A one-feature WFS sample, non-area proxy or synthetic scene was not staged.

reportPresentation.reason: The exact table communicates the decisive complete 5,122-row register versus zero verified fixed geometry artifacts more accurately than a chart.

blockerSummary: Posten's current 5,122-row G/P/B/S register is publicly downloadable but no dataset-specific AGID processing and public-serving grant was established. Kartverket/data.norge advertises official monthly postcode areas under CC BY 4.0, but the WFS/download hosts timed out in this run and no fixed geometry body, SHA-256, full topology/coverage audit or 5,122-code area/non-area reconciliation exists. No approved real NO runtime/API/UI artifact can therefore pass.
unblockConditions: Establish a reviewed Posten dataset grant permitting AGID processing, reconciliation, derived artifacts and public serving, or an equivalent expressly open current complete assignment/category release.

Download a fixed current Kartverket Postnummerområder artifact under CC BY 4.0 and pin edition, reference date, attribution, byte length, SHA-256, schema, source CRS, transform, coverage and exclusions.

Validate every Polygon/MultiPolygon and reconcile all 5,122 assignments to an official area or explicit non-area while retaining G/P/B/S and NO/SJ identity; invent no municipality, point, building, buffer, hull, Voronoi/raster or synthetic proxy.
Build an approved immutable artifact and pass real NO loader, API, normalization, geometry validity, map fit, translucent fill, outline, provenance, clear and re-search verification.
